acctAlertFillFields: Please enter a description and amount.
acctDesc: The mill's income and expenses. Entries are posted automatically when an order is closed: milling (income), selling (income) and buying (expense). Other transactions can be added below; only those can be deleted.
aiAdv_lower_buy: Plenty in stock: buy less (lower the buying price)
aiAdv_raise_buy: Stock is running low: buy more (raise the buying price)
aiAdvisedBuy: buying price about {price} (edge of the margin range)
aiAlertMargin: {mat}: the current price is outside its margin range.
aiAlertPowerIdle: {day}: {kwh} kWh used with no paddy milled.
aiAlertSupply: Agricultural production index {month}: {pct}% vs last year. Check paddy buying prices.
aiAlertYield: Milling order #{id}: {got} kg rice received, {exp} kg expected ({pct}%). Check the scale or the yield ratios.
aiAlertsNote: Checked: milled rice vs expected yield (±10%), kWh per kg vs the usual day (×1.5), machine faults and long running, prices outside their margin range, national agricultural production more than 10% from last year.
aiAskNote: Only totals of this branch are sent (no customer names or phone numbers). Check important answers on the screens.
aiAskPh: For example: How much paddy is waiting? Which product should we buy more of?
aiDesc: Forecasts, price advice and alerts are worked out from this branch's own data. Ask the system answers questions with the help of an AI service.
aiErrNotConfigured: The AI service is not set up.
aiErrService: The AI service did not answer. Check the internet connection and the API key, then try again.
aiForecastNote: Average of the same weekday over the last {weeks} weeks.
aiForecastThin: Not much history yet: the forecast gets better as orders build up.
aiMillAsk: Ask AI about the milling (yield, waiting, holds)
aiMillAskQ: Look at milling_analysis_last_30_days: is the yield on target per variety, where is time lost (waiting, milling, holds, pickup), and what should we change? Keep it short.
aiMillNote: From the status timeline of the orders registered in the last 30 days. Open Milling Analysis for other periods, per customer and the CSV export.
aiNotConfigured: Ask the system is switched off: add AOI_AI_API_KEY to the .env file and restart.
aiPriceNote: Rules: under 3 days of stock → buy more; over 30 days → buy less, using the margin ranges. Prices change only when you approve them on Pricing Maintenance.
alertCustInfoRequired: Please enter the customer name before proceeding with a buy/sell order.
apCaution: An AI can be wrong: its price is one source only, never the base price unless you choose it. Check the source links before deciding.

apErrNoSources: The AI gave no sources, so nothing was saved.
apErrService: The AI could not be reached - try again later.
apFetched: AI ({provider}) searched: {n} product(s) saved · not found / not passed: {skipped}
apHistConfirm: Let the AI search the monthly averages of the last 3 years for every product? An estimate from the web, for the trend only (about 1 minute).
apNote: Once a day the AI searches today's market price of every product in {region} (THB/kg low-high, with the source)
apSetup: No AI connected: put AOI_GEMINI_API_KEY (Google AI Studio) or AOI_AI_API_KEY in .env and restart the server.
apTitle: Market prices found on the web by AI
autoKeyNote: Copy it into the device now: it is shown only this once. Keep it secret; anyone with the key can send data as this device.
bbErrNone: Choose at least one SKU to show.
bbErrSide: {sku}: choose the buying or the selling price (or both).
bbMsgPh: e.g. We buy paddy every day 07:00-17:00

bbMusicDeleted: Music file deleted, back to the built-in tune.
bbMusicErrSize: The file is larger than {mb} MB.
bbMusicErrTheme: Choose the Christmas or Songkran theme.
bbMusicErrType: This file is not MP3 / M4A / OGG / WAV.

bbMusicNeedKey: Issue the TV link first to listen here
bbMusicNote: Christmas: public-domain carols (Jingle Bells, Silent Night, We Wish You a Merry Christmas, Deck the Halls) on a music box. Songkran: an original cheerful tune written for AOI (Thai pentatonic, ranat xylophone, khong, klong drum, ching-chap, ramwong beat), not a copyrighted Songkran song. Made in the browser, no audio files; starts after one tap or remote key press.
bbMusicOn: Play soft music with the Christmas and Songkran themes
bbMusicSaved: Music file saved. The billboard plays it from its next refresh.
bbNote: Paddy prices depend on quality and moisture
bbNotePh: e.g. 50 kg or more: 1 THB/kg off
bbSetNote: Choose the SKUs, their order, the buying / selling price, a promotion note per SKU and the running messages. The billboard follows within 15 seconds.
bbSkuHint: Tick the prices to show (the branch's current prices). Order 1 is shown first.
bbXmas: Merry Christmas and Happy New Year
bbXmasEn: Merry Christmas and Happy New Year
bsBuyCloseNote: The goods are received into the mill's stock and the order is closed (the expense is posted).
bsBuyNote: Buying prices are the branch's current prices. Open: the order waits on the Buying/Selling Order List. Close: the goods are received now.
bsClosedNote: Newest first (closed or cancelled most recently); the newest {n} are shown - search to find older ones.
bsEditNote: Change the kg of bran / broken rice the customer takes. The amount is recalculated as at registration (milling discount up to the customer's own output); the milling order follows.
bsEditNotePrepared: The goods are already prepared: the stock kept for the customer is corrected too. The amount is recalculated; the milling order follows.
bsSellNote: Selling prices are the branch's current prices. Open: the order waits on the Buying/Selling Order List. Close: the goods leave stock now.
bsWaitMillingNote: Can be prepared when milling order #{id} is finished.
cancelRequestBlockNote: Answer this request before the order can be set to {status}.
cancelRequestNotice: Customer requested cancellation via the LINE app
closeOrderDetailsTitle: Items that will be released from inventory for this order
cmdSelectThenStart: Switch the mill selector, then ON
confirmAddBuyToInventory: Add the purchased item to inventory now?
confirmAddLastOutput: Last item remaining: add {name} ({qty} kg) to finish receiving this order's output?
confirmAddToInventory: Add the milled output to inventory now?
confirmApproveCancel: Approve this cancellation request? The order moves to Hold until the cancellation is completed. Enter the hold reason next.
confirmBackMilling: Back to the milling order now, to close it?
confirmCancelBsOrder: Cancel order #{id}? This cannot be undone.
confirmCancelOrder: Cancel order #{id}? This cannot be undone. The rice, bran and broken rice kept for the customer become the mill's stock with status "Pending maintenance", to be checked in Inventory.
confirmCloseBsKeep: Close order #{id}? The goods ({stock}) stay in stock for the customer and leave when milling order #{ml} is Closed (picked up with the rice). This cannot be undone.
confirmCloseBsOrder: Close order #{id}? The stock kept for it is released ({stock}). This cannot be undone.
confirmCloseBuy: Close order #{id}? An expense of {amount} THB is posted. This cannot be undone.
confirmCloseOrder: Close order #{id}? The payment is posted to the account ledger and the order cannot be reopened.
confirmCloseQuestion: Confirm closing the order and releasing this stock from inventory?
confirmCloseRelease:
This order's stock is at: {locations}
Confirm closing the order and releasing that stock from inventory?
confirmCloseSellDirect: Close order #{id}? {qty} kg of {mat} is released from stock (on hand: {available} kg). This cannot be undone.
confirmElecPost: Post this month's electricity cost to Account as an expense?
confirmGoOrderList: Go to the order list now? Choose No to register the next order here.
confirmInboundDoneReturn: All items have been received into inventory. Return to the Milling Status screen?
confirmMcReset: Reset the fault of {name}? Check the machine first.
confirmMcStart: Send START to {name}? Make sure nobody is working at the machine.
confirmNewKey: Issue a new device key for {id}? The old key stops working at once.
confirmOpenLinked: Open its buying/selling orders now (take-home bran / broken rice) to prepare and close them?
confirmOrderCreated: Order created ({count} item(s)). Go to the Buying/Selling Order List screen?
confirmPrepareSellDirect: Mark order #{id} as prepared? The stock is released when the order is closed.
confirmPrepareSellQuestion: Confirm preparing this order and releasing this stock from inventory?
confirmPrepareSellStore: Prepare the product and store it in an inventory location now? (Stock is released when the order is closed.)
confirmPrepareTakeOrder: This order has a pre-order for pickup: {name} ({qty} kg). Prepare it for inventory? (suggested location: {location})
confirmPriceSaved: Price saved. This rate will apply to Buy/Sell orders completed from now on.
confirmQueueNow: Queue a milling order for this customer now?
confirmRecordCancel: Record that the customer asked to cancel order #{id}?
confirmRequeueApproved: Order #{id} has an approved cancellation. Return it to the queue anyway?
confirmReturnBuySellStatus: Item received into inventory. Return to the Buy/Sell Status screen?
confirmReturnService: Go back to Customer Service with this customer?
confirmTypeToTakeawayFromDelivery: Change order #{id} to take-away? The status will return to {status}.
cpActive: Campaign on (points count within the dates)
cpConfirmUngive: Undo the hand-over of '{gift}' to {name}? (back to pending)
cpDesc: Customers collect points from the kg they use (10 kg = 1 point, adjustable) in 3 types: milling, buying from customers and selling to customers. Each type has 3 rank gifts (one customer each: most points = rank 1) and one special gift drawn on the lucky wheel.
cpEmptySave: The campaign is not saved yet: type the gifts of each level, switch "Campaign on" and press Save. The customers' points table appears here (orders registered within the campaign dates).
cpErrGiven: This gift was already handed over.
cpErrLevels: The points of the levels must go up (1 < 2 < 3).
cpErrMin: The minimum points must be at least 1.
cpErrNoEntrants: No customer can enter the draw yet.
cpErrNoSpecial: No special gift set for this type.
cpErrNotFinal: The campaign has not ended: gifts and the draw are after {day}.
cpErrNotGiven: This gift is not recorded as handed over.
cpErrNotReached: The customer has not reached this level.
cpMinPoints: Minimum points to take part (rank / draw)
cpNoEntrants: No customer has the minimum points yet.
cpNoPoints: No customer has points in this type yet.
cpNotRunning_inactive: The campaign is off: switch "Campaign on" and save.
cpNotRunning_scheduled: The campaign has not started: points count from orders on and after the start date.
cpProvisional: The ranking can change until the campaign's last day ({day}); gifts and the special draw come after it.
cpRules: Points add up per customer and type: milling counts finished orders (weighed paddy), buying / selling count closed orders, registered within the campaign. Ranks 1-3 are the 3 customers with the most points (ties: more kg, then who got there first). Every customer with the minimum points (ranks 1-3 too) enters the special draw, chance by points.
cpWheelNote: The wheel can be spun many times; every spin is a new random draw and is kept. The latest is the winner shown on the campaign page. Every customer with the minimum points is in, slices sized by points.
cpnCardHow: Show this QR at the counter when milling or buying rice. One use only.
cpnConfirmCancel: Cancel coupon {id}? The customer cannot use it any more.
cpnCustPh: Customer code, or scan the customer card
cpnDesc: Issue a coupon to one customer; it is sent only by LINE. The customer shows it when milling or buying rice; staff scan it on the order to lower the payment. Used once; if it is worth more than the payment, the rest is lost.
cpnErrCustomer: This coupon belongs to {name}; it cannot be used on another customer's order.
cpnErrExpire: The expiry cannot be before today.
cpnErrNoLine: {name} is not linked to LINE; coupons go only by LINE.
cpnErrNotActive: This coupon cannot be used any more.
cpnErrNotFound: Coupon not found (or of another branch).
cpnErrNothing: Nothing to pay on this order.
cpnErrOrder: Coupons work only on open milling orders and customer buying orders.
cpnErrOrderHas: This order already has a coupon (one per order).
cpnErrValue: The coupon value must be {lo}-{hi} THB.
cpnLineText: 🎁 {name}: a discount coupon of {value} THB ({camp}), valid until {expire}. Show this QR when milling or buying rice. One use only.
cpnMsgAppliedForfeit: Coupon {id} used: -{amt} THB ({forfeit} THB left over is lost; the coupon cannot be used again).
cpnMsgIssued: Coupon {id} issued and sent by LINE.
cpnMsgIssuedNotSent: Coupon {id} issued, but LINE did not send it (check LINE / the https address). Use 'Send LINE again' later.
cpnMsgRemoved: Coupon removed; it can be used again.
cpnNoLineCustomers: No customer is linked to LINE yet.
cpnNotePh: e.g. Thank you for your support
currentPriceBranchNote: Prices for {branch}, the branch you signed in to.
custCardAlsoLine: Also send to the customer's LINE
custCardLineOff: LINE is not connected (or no right to send): printed only.
custCardNoLine: Not linked to LINE: printed only.
custCardNote: Show this QR when you come for milling, buying or selling.
custConfirmDelete: Delete customer {code} ({name})? A customer with past orders is hidden; the history stays.
custConfirmNote: Check the details. The name must not be registered yet.
custDistanceNote: Used for the delivery fee. Leave blank if not known.
custErrDailyLimit: No more customer codes are available today (999 per day).
custErrDistance: The distance must be a number, 0 or more.
custErrDupName: The name "{name}" is already registered ({code}). Open that customer, or add something to tell them apart.
custErrLineUser: The LINE user ID is U followed by 32 characters 0-9 and a-f.
custErrMobile: Enter the mobile number with digits only (dashes and spaces are fine), 6 to 15 digits.
custErrOpenOrders: This customer has {n} open order(s). Close or cancel them before deleting.
custErrRequired: Enter the name, phone and address.
custErrSelect: Select a customer to edit first.
custHidden: Customer {code} deleted. The order history is kept for the accounts and the analysis.
custLineLinked: LINE linked: {name} · {date} · {via}. New queue tickets no longer show the LINE QR.
custLineRelinkNote: Scan this QR with the LINE account that should get the messages (for example a family member's phone), then tap Send. It replaces the current LINE account.
custLineUnlinkConfirm: Remove the LINE account of {name}? The next queue ticket shows the LINE QR again.
custLineVia_STAFF_QR: by the QR on Customer Maintenance
custQrNote: Holds the customer code. Scan it on Customer Service to choose this customer.
custSearchPh: Search name, phone or customer code
dash24h: Disk, memory and CPU, last 24 hours
dashApiHourly: Calls per hour, last 24 h (red: with errors)
dashBarNote: One bar per order registered today: height = paddy (kg), colour = status.
dashNoHistory: The line appears after a few checks (every 5 minutes).
dashNoTrade: No buying or selling orders yet.
dashRateNote: Price per kg of the last orders (oldest left).
deliveryRetryNote: If a delivery fails, update the details and confirm again, or close the order.
demoBanner: Demo mode: no database is connected, so nothing is saved when the server stops.
demoHint: Tap an account to fill it in. The password for every account is {pw}.
detQtyLockedNote: The order is Finished: the paddy weight and take-home quantities can no longer change.
detRecalcNote: Outputs, charges and receive time are recalculated when you save. Reprint the QR label if the payment changed.
elApiNote: A smart meter sends readings to /api/v1/meters/<ID>/readings with the header X-Device-Key, for example {"kwh": 12345.6}. Try it with scripts/device_sim.py.
elDesc: Electricity use from the meters (typed in or sent by a smart meter), its cost at the branch rate, and kWh per kg of paddy milled.
elNoMeters: No meters yet. Add them under Meter setup.
elPostNote: Posts the month's cost (all meters × rate) as an expense once. To correct it, delete the entry on Account and post again.
elReadingNote: Type the number shown on the meter (it only goes up). The use since the previous reading is worked out.
errAcctAmount: The amount must be greater than 0.
errBadRequest: The form has expired or the request was not valid. Go back, reload the page and try again.
errCancelReason: Please enter the reason for cancelling.
errCancelRequestNotAllowed: A cancellation request is accepted only while the order is in Queue or In process, and only one at a time.
errDailyOrderLimit: No more order numbers are available today (9,999 per day).
errDeliveryFee: The delivery fee per km cannot be negative.
errElecMonth: Enter the electricity bill per month (0 or more).
errElecNothing: There is nothing to post: no use recorded, or the rate is 0.
errElecPosted: This month is already posted ({ref}). Delete that entry on Account first to post again.
errElecRate: Enter a rate from 0 to 100 THB per kWh.
errFeeUnit: The unit weight must be more than 0 and the fee cannot be negative.
errFloorCeiling: {mat}: the floor cannot be above the ceiling.
errForbidden: Your role is not allowed to do this. Contact an administrator.
errHoldReason: Enter a reason for putting the order on hold.
errInvNotFound: This stock record was not found at this branch.
errInvRemark: Enter a remark for the reason Other.
errLabourDay: Enter a labour cost from 0 to 100,000 THB per day.

errLocBlocked: Location {loc} is blocked. Choose another location.
errLocFormat: Enter the 8 digits of the storage location, for example 01002005 (it becomes 01-002-005).
errMachineBusy: A command for this machine is still waiting. Try again when it is done.
errMachineNoControl: Remote start/stop is not set up for this machine.
errMachineOffline: The device is not connected, so the command cannot be sent.
errMachineUnknown: This machine was not found at this branch.
errMarginRange: Enter a range like 3-7 (from 0 to 100, from not above to).
errMeterFuture: The reading time cannot be in the future.
errMeterLower: The reading is lower than the last one ({last} kWh). Check the number.

errMeterReading: Enter the meter reading (0 or more).
errMeterUnknown: This meter was not found at this branch.
errMillingNotFinished: Milling order #{id} is not finished yet. Prepare this order after the milling is finished.
errNoItems: Enter a quantity for at least one product.
errNoPendingRequest: This order has no cancellation request waiting for an answer.
errNoPrice: There is no current price for {mat} at this branch. Set it on Pricing Maintenance first.
errNotFound: The page or record was not found.

errOrderEnded: This order is already closed or cancelled and cannot be changed.
errOrderNotFound: The order was not found at this branch.
errOrderPriceRange: The price must be between {lo} and {hi} THB/kg.
errOtherMotorRunning: {name} is running. Only one main motor can run at a time: stop it first.
errOutboundShort: Not enough stock at {loc}: {have} kg free, {need} kg needed.
errOutboundShortMat: {mat}: Not enough stock at {loc}: {have} kg free, {need} kg needed.
errPendingRequest: Answer the customer's cancellation request first.
errPeriods: Enter at least one receiving period as HH:MM, separated by commas.
errPlanKg: Enter the planned paddy per day from 0 to 1,000,000 kg.
errPriceApproveRight: Approving a price needs the Approve right.
errPriceNotNow: The price can be changed only on orders not closed yet, and not on a milling order's take-home order.
errPriceRange: Enter a number within the allowed range.
errPriceReason: Please enter the reason for the price.
errPriceRight: No right to change the price (Approve right needed).
errPriceUnknown: This product has no price record at this branch.
errProcCost: Enter a processing cost from 0 to 100 THB per kg.
errQtyLocked: The paddy weight and take-home quantities can only change before the order is Finished.
errScadaPlace: SCADA column must be 0-5 and row 0-3.
errScanRequired: Scan the QR label on the paddy of order #{id} to start milling.
errScanWrong: This QR label is not order #{id}. Check the bag: scan the label of this order.
errSelectorMotorRunning: Stop {name} first: the mill selector can only switch while no main motor runs. If {name} has already stopped but its device is offline, set its status to Idle on Hardware Control (after checking the motor).
errSelectorNotHere: {selector} is not switched to {name}. Switch it first (SCADA > mill selector), then start.

errServer: Something went wrong on the server. Try again.

errStatusNotAllowed: This change is not allowed for the order's current status.
errTimePerKg: The time per kg must be more than 0.
errTryAgain: The record could not be saved. Try again.
errWorkdays: Enter the working days per month (1 to 31).

fieldLineUserNote: Not the LINE ID above: LINE gives this ID (U + 32 characters) when the customer adds the mill's LINE Official Account. Your own one is on LINE Developers > the channel > Basic settings > Your user ID.
heldForPickup: Still in stock, picked up with milling order #{ml}: {qty} kg at {stock}
hlApi5xxMsg: {n} request(s) ended with a server error (5xx) in the last hour.
hlApi5xxTodo: See the app log below for the screen and the error.

hlAskQuestion: Explain the server health warnings: what is the risk and what should I do now?

hlFaultsMsg: {n} machine fault(s) in the last 24 hours ({ids}).
hlFaultsTodo: See the status history on Hardware Control; check the motor before starting again.

hlLineTokenMsg: LINE refuses the channel access token.

hlLineUnreachableMsg: The LINE API cannot be reached from the server.

holdReasonPrompt: Reason for putting order #{id} on hold (required)
homeNoAccess: Your role has no screens it can open. Contact an administrator.
huskHint: No market feed, no suggestion, set by admin only
hwApiNote: Devices send their status to /api/v1/machines/<ID>/status and fetch start/stop from /api/v1/machines/<ID>/commands with the header X-Device-Key. Try it with scripts/device_sim.py.
hwDesc: Machine status, start/stop and the status history. Without a connected device, set the status by hand; a connected device reports it and carries out start/stop.
inboundMillingNote: The milled rice is received into inventory for the customer, and the order becomes Finished.
inboundTakeHomeNote: The bran and broken rice the customer takes home are prepared on the Buying/Selling Order List.
insufficientStockWarning: Warning: on-hand stock ({available} kg) is less than the quantity sold ({needed} kg)
invAddNote: The item is added to the mill's own stock. Husk from milling is registered here.
invLowStockNone: Every product has at least {kg} kg of the mill's own stock.
invSearchPh: Search product, lot, location or customer
invStatusNote: Leave the quantity blank to change the whole location.
ivActualNote: Actual figures come from the Account ledger: closed milling orders = milling fee, selling orders = sales, buying orders = purchase, electricity postings = electricity; manual entries use the category chosen on the entry.
ivBeChartNote: Per month. Where the revenue line crosses the total cost line is the break-even point; left of it is a loss, right of it a profit.
ivBudgetFill: Fill labour & electricity from Milling Maintenance
ivBudgetNote: Amount per year. Fixed costs count in the break-even point; variable costs are compared with the actual figures only (the break-even uses the per-kg costs).
ivCapexNote: Depreciation is straight line: (amount - salvage value) / useful life. Land and working capital are not depreciated.
ivDraftNote: Draft for review: the screens, formulas and sample figures may still change.
ivErrCapexFields: Enter the item name and amount.
ivErrLoanYears: Enter the number of years of the loan.
ivErrNothingToCopy: Nothing to copy: last year has no budget, or this year already has every line.
ivErrNothingToFill: Nothing to fill: labour and electricity already have a budget (or are not set on Milling Maintenance).
ivErrRange: A value is out of range.
ivErrSalvage: The salvage value cannot be more than the amount.
ivErrSampleExists: This factory already has investment items.
ivLifeNote: Leave the life empty to use the category's usual life; 0 = not depreciated.
ivLoanNote: Equal yearly payment {pay} THB; interest in year 1: {interest} THB (a fixed cost).
ivMixNote: Service milling: the mill earns the milling fee and the by-products (bran, broken rice, husk) the customer leaves. The rest is paddy the mill buys, mills and sells (trading).
ivMsgSample: Sample project added. Review and change the figures.
ivNoBeNote: Revenue per kg does not cover the variable cost per kg, so there is no break-even point. Check the business mix, the milling fee and the prices.
ivPerKgNote: Prices, yields and the electricity per kg come from Pricing Maintenance (profit check). Labour is a fixed budget line, so it is not counted per kg.
ivPlannedNote: The planned paddy per day and working days per month are set on Milling Maintenance.
ivSampleConfirm: Add sample investment items, loan and budget to this factory? You can edit or delete them later.
ivUsedNote: The bar shows the actual against the year's budget; the mark is the budget to date ({m} of 12 months).
ivYearsNote: Same volume, prices and budget every year (no growth or inflation yet). The highlighted year is when the investment is paid back. Loan principal is shown for information; it is not a cost.
lblLabourDay: Labour cost per worker per day (THB)
lblProcCostKg: Other processing cost per kg paddy (THB)
linkMlPrompt: Milling order of the same customer for order #{id} (ML-YYYYMMDD-NNNN or scan the label). Leave empty to remove the link.
linkedOpenNote: Close / Cancel waits for the buying/selling order {ids} to be closed or cancelled.

maDesc: Every status change of the milling orders is recorded (time, user, reason, QR scan, weights). Here are the orders registered in the period: how long customers waited, how long milling took, holds and cancellations, and the real yield (rice received / weighed paddy) against the expected one, per variety and per customer.
maExportNote: CSV files open in Excel or Google Sheets (Thai text included).
maNote: Averages use only the orders that have the value (for example, the yield needs the rice received at Finished). Weighed paddy is used when the QR was scanned, otherwise the registered paddy.
maintBranchNote: Prices and margins are set separately for each branch.
marginNote: Suggested buy = market × (1 − buy target %), suggested sell = market × (1 + sell target %), kept between the floor and ceiling. The ranges mark prices whose margin is acceptable.
marketUpdateNote: Until a market price feed is connected, type the market prices here. The suggestion is recalculated and waits for approval.

mcScadaHint: SCADA: column 0-5 (silos, conveyors, inbound & sorting, milling, packing & storage), row 0-3; Feeds to = machine IDs, comma separated.
mcSpeedNote: 50 Hz = 1450 rpm. ON starts at the last speed set. The mill never runs in reverse.
millPriceNote: Blank = the branch price. Typing a price needs the Approve right (super user) and a reason.
millPriceOvrNote: Price set by hand: bran {bran} / broke {broke} THB/kg by {user}: {reason}
millTimeRuleShort: Milling time = paddy weight (kg) x time per kg, inside operating hours.
millingCostNote: Labour, sacks, maintenance and so on, per kg of paddy. Electricity is counted separately from Automation > Electricity.
millingDeliveryNote: Delivery fee = the customer's distance (km) x this rate. Set 0 for free delivery.
millingElecNote: Without meter readings, electricity per kg = bill per month ÷ (planned paddy per day × working days). With readings on Automation > Electricity, the meters are used.
millingFeeNote: Charged on the rice output, rounded up to full units. For example, 120 kg counts as 3 units.
millingLabourNote: Labour per kg = labour per day ÷ paddy milled per day (average of the days with orders in the last 30 days; full capacity before there are orders). Used by the profit check on Pricing Maintenance.
millingLabourNote2: Labour per kg = labour per day ÷ planned paddy per day (default 2,000 kg). Set it to 0 to use the real average of the days with orders in the last 30 days instead. Used by the profit check on Pricing Maintenance.
millingProdDesc: Configure the output ratio: for 1 kg of paddy, how many kg of rice, bran, broken rice, and husk are received.
millingProdYieldNote: e.g. 3,000 kg paddy x 0.5152 = 1,545.6 kg rice. The four ratios together must not exceed 1 (100%).
millingTimeFormulaDesc: Used to calculate each queued order's expected receiving time.
millingTimeRuleCalc: Milling time = weight (kg) × time parameter per kg.
millingTimeRuleExclude: Orders with status Hold, Completed, or Cancelled are not included in the queue calculation.
millingTimeRuleGap: A gap, set below, is added between orders before the next one starts (default 1 minute).
millingTimeRuleHours: Milling is only scheduled within operating hours (default 9:00-18:00). If the queue runs past closing time, remaining orders roll to the next operating day.
millingTimeRulePeriod: The time told to customers is rounded up to a fixed receiving period (e.g. 10:00, 13:00, 16:00, 18:00). The exact calculated time is for internal operator use only.

psAiCard: Price trend and buy / sell points
psAskQuestion: Look at price_signals for {name} (signal: {label}). Compare the sources (farm, millers, export, my buying / selling prices), explain the trend, and say whether now is a time to buy, hold or sell, at which price to take profit and where to stop the loss. Keep it short.
psDesc: All price sources of each product on one chart - NABC farm prices, the rice millers' report, the rice exporters' FOB prices (world market), the applied market price and your own buying / selling prices - with the trend and buy / sell points worked out like a stock chart, and the profit / loss, take profit and stop loss of your stock.
psDisclaimer: Signals are statistics on past prices, not a promise of future prices. Prices only change when a person approves them on Pricing Maintenance.
psErrDownload: The exporters' price page could not be downloaded. Try again later, or import a saved copy of the page.
psErrNoFile: Choose the saved page file first.
psErrNoRows: No prices found on the page. Import a saved copy (HTML or PDF), or check AOI_EXPORT_URL.
psErrSma: The short average must be shorter than the long one.
psFetched: Export prices: {rows} price(s) read, {new} new, newest {day}.
psMethod: Method: the base source is filled day by day. Score: RSI under 30 +2 / under 40 +1 / over 60 -1 / over 70 -2; under the lower band +2, over the upper band -2; a cross in the last 7 days +2 (golden) / -2 (death), otherwise short over long +1 / under -1. 3 or more strong buy, 1-2 buy, -1 to -2 sell, -3 or less strong sell, else hold.
psNoCost: No cost known: no buying order in 90 days and no branch buying price. Type your cost above.
psNoDataTodo: Fetch the export prices below, map the product on Financial > Market prices, or choose another base source.
psNoItems: No export price stored yet: fetch now or import the page.
psSrcNote_AIHIST: monthly averages the AI estimated from the web - for the trend only
psSrcNote_AIWEB: the AI searches the web once a day, with sources
psSrcNote_BUY: own buying orders, kg-weighted per day
psSrcNote_SELL: own selling orders, kg-weighted per day
psState_gain: In profit; sell at {tp} (take profit), protect at {sl} (stop loss).
psState_loss: At a loss; the stop loss is {sl}, break-even at your cost.
psState_nostock: No free stock now: compare the buy point with your cost before buying ({sl} - {tp}).
psState_sl: Stop-loss level reached ({sl}): consider selling to cut the loss and buying less.
psState_tp: Take-profit level reached ({tp}): a good time to sell stock.
psTnBuyHigh: Bought {pct}% above the market in this period - check the branch's buying price.
psTnBuyLow: Bought {pct}% below the market - good, but customers may sell elsewhere.
psTnNoMargin: The average selling price is not above the average buying price (margin {m} THB/kg): no profit on this SKU yet.
psTnNone: No buying or selling of this SKU in AOI in the period shown.
psTnSellLow: Sold {pct}% below the market - the selling price could go up.
psTnSlowStock: The stock lasts {d} more days at the current sales - buy less or find more buyers.
psTradeNote: From customer selling orders (the mill buys) and customer buying orders (the mill sells) in the period shown, cancelled ones left out, against the main market price on the same days.
psTreaDesc: Weekly FOB Bangkok prices of the Thai Rice Exporters Association (US$ per metric ton), turned into THB/kg with the exchange rate. Export prices are milled rice at the port: use them for the direction of the world market, not as a mill-gate price. Fetched every day with the other market prices; a saved copy of the page (HTML or PDF) can also be imported.
psUnitNote: Prices THB/kg. Buy point = support or the lower band (cheap); sell point = resistance or the upper band (expensive). Profit / loss of the stock on hand at the latest base price.
psUpload: Or import a saved page (HTML / PDF)

psWhyNone: No clear sign: the price is flat.
psWhyOverBand: over the upper band ({band}): unusually expensive
psWhyRsiHigh: RSI {rsi}: overbought, the price is high
psWhyRsiLow: RSI {rsi}: oversold, the price is low
psWhyUnderBand: under the lower band ({band}): unusually cheap
psWhyUp: short average above the long one: up trend
